name: Weak vs Strong SpongeBob
look: Four boxes in a 2x2 grid. Left column: ordinary SpongeBob smiling and gesturing on the sandy sea floor (top), and a hugely muscular, scowling SpongeBob in a red headband standing in an arena beside Mr. Krabs (bottom). The right column holds two blank white boxes.
use: Compares a weak, ordinary version of something with a strong, impressive one. The top right box names the feeble version and the bottom right box names the powerful version, often a silly reason to feel mighty.
slots: the weak or ordinary version (top right box)
the strong, buff version (bottom right box)
examples: Me opening a jar when someone is watching
describe: normal spongebob next to buff muscular spongebob
skinny sponge vs ripped sponge with a headband
spongebob weak on top and strong with big muscles below
cartoon sponge flexing huge arms with mr krabs behind him
regular vs jacked spongebob with blank boxes on the right
origin: Two stills of SpongeBob from SpongeBob SquarePants, one ordinary and one comically muscular.
